title: NO RAIDERS ON SCREEN: THE AI ONES ARE PILLAGER BOTS
why: His order 2026-10-18: get rid of the concept of raiders; players are pillagers and the AI ones are pillager bots. Every string a player reads that meant an AI pillager now says pillager bot(s): the settings rows and option, the board title, the sound key, the callouts, the contract words, the run report line, the hints and the bush note. Code names (kind raider, CFG.nRaider, saves) are unchanged.
now: The AI humans are now called pillager bots everywhere on screen, and raider is gone.
